basic_info.description: Penthouse 528 at 88 Arkansas is a rare top-floor corner unit in this recent-build, boutique development  now offered at a compelling new price. BOTH bedrooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows and views: the second bedroom looks west to Twin Peaks and Sutro and includes a large walk-in closet, while the primary en suite frames tree-lined Jackson Rec Park. This 2-bed, 2-bath home offers uncommon quiet, abundant natural light, and a crisp, modern layout that feels warm and elevated  especially with central A/C. A French balcony opens to the landscaped courtyard below. Inside: 9-ft ceilings, white oak floors, matte cabinetry, quartz counters, and built-in Bertazzoni and Bosch appliances. Bosch in-unit laundry is conveniently located just outside the second bedroom. The unit and building are immaculate  visitors say so when they visit. One floor up: a rooftop terrace with skyline views, BBQs, fire pits, green space, dining, and loungers. Building features include 2 key fob elevators, ButterflyMX entry, attended lobby, secure package delivery, dog wash, bike room, and assigned garage parking, plus plenty of street parking nearby. Close to Whole Foods, Philz, Arch Art Supply, the SF Flower Mart, UCSF Mission Bay, Dogpatch, 18th Street, Chase Center, and much more.
